Package com.nexuslink.core.env

Class SecretMaskingFilter

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.core.env.SecretMaskingFilter
public final class SecretMaskingFilter extends Object
Keeps secret values from leaking into logs and the UI. Two jobs:
  • looksSecret(String) — a name heuristic used to default a variable's "secret" flag so passwords/tokens/keys are masked without the user having to remember to tick the box.
  • scrub(String) — replaces every occurrence of a known secret value in arbitrary text (a log line, a rendered request) with MASK, so a copied URL or logged body never reveals the real secret. The UI keeps the plaintext for its own reveal toggle.
